spec_features.feature_name: early stop on submit-pass or give_up
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:160-162 sets terminal when event.is_terminal and breaks at 174-175. tools.py:201-203 _t_give_up returns is_terminal=True; tools.py:205-211 _t_submit sets is_terminal=passed (terminal only when tests pass). The loop honors it and breaks, ending the episode.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired end-to-end: give_up always terminates; submit terminates only on passing tests. Outcome recorded as submit_pass/give_up at agent.py:162.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Verify by running tests; submit only "succeeds" if they pass. (tools.py:206)

spec_features.spec_quote: `give_up` is an explicit, first-class action so that "stop with a stated reason" is a measurable outcome
spec_features.evidence: give_up is a real tool in the schema (tools.py:99-107, requires `reason`), has a handler _t_give_up (tools.py:201-203) returning is_terminal=True, and the loop dispatches/honors it (agent.py:135,160-162,174-175), recording outcome='give_up'.
spec_features.notes: The reason argument is captured in turn.tool_calls/arguments, making 'stop with a stated reason' a measurable outcome.

spec_features.feature_name: give_up lets a model that wants to stop do so
spec_features.spec_quote: let a model that wants to stop do so via `give_up`
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as above: give_up tool (tools.py:99-107), _t_give_up returns is_terminal=True (tools.py:201-203), loop breaks (agent.py:160-162,174-175). System prompt also offers it (agent.py:30-33) and tool description 'Declare that you cannot solve the task and stop.' The subject can elect to end the session at will.
spec_features.notes: Enforced: calling give_up immediately ends the episode regardless of progress.

spec_features.spec_quote: `max_turns = 20` — long enough to see escalation develop, short enough to bound cost
spec_features.evidence: config.py:64 max_turns: int = 20; enforced by `for turn_idx in range(cfg.max_turns)` at agent.py:106, after which the loop exits with outcome default 'max_turns' (agent.py:59).
spec_features.notes: Real bound on episode length, checked and read by the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Max agent turns ... The loop also stops early if the agent calls `submit`/`give_up`. (config.py:62-63); 'short enough to bound cost' is design prose, code comment is cost/integrity-oriented

spec_features.feature_name: not a claim about welfare/inner experience
spec_features.spec_quote: This measures *expressed* behavior in outputs. It is **not** a claim about model welfare or inner experience
spec_features.evidence: This framing exists only as prose in DESIGN.md and as comments/docstrings (e.g. __init__.py:9-11 'naive "is it distressed" framing'; metrics.py:13). No code path enforces or acts on it; it is not a runtime mechanism. The judge axes (config.py:109-120) measure expressed behavior but no code implements the disclaimer as behavior.
